title: heimdal.observation.published payload (v1)
description: Payload of the heimdal.observation.published outbox-envelope event (Epic #3019 slice A4, #3041). Canonical published-observation contract per docs/HEIMDAL/FABLE_COMPANION.md §1.3 (prose mirror; this schema is canonical at enactment, ADR-0049 §1/§5). Producer: app.heimdal.publish.publish_observation (A2, #3039), appending onto the append-only observation log (app.heimdal.observation_log). Envelope timestamp (event/event_id/trace_id/source/timestamp/payload/meta) is emission time only -- observation time lives in this payload's time family (§1.2, HEIM-10). Field families: identity, time (bitemporal), actors (attributions), entities (entity_mentions), content, confidence, provenance, sensitivity/consent. Payload rule 1 (§1.3): no published event without observation_id, episode_id, observed_at_start, at least one attribution, confidence, provenance.content_hash + content_identity + capture_chain, sensitivity, and consent (consent.grant_ref required, HEIM-3).

observation_id.description: Identity family: stable identity of this observation (§1.3 identity).

episode_id.description: Identity family: groups observations from one continuous capture session (§1.3/§1.4 -- one voice memo = one episode).

sequence.description: Identity family: monotone integer within the episode.

revision_of.description: Identity family: marks re-processing of the same raw evidence through improved stages (references a prior observation_id, never edits it -- HEIM-1).

supersedes.description: Identity family: marks a correction (§3.5); references the prior observation_id being corrected. Never edits -- always append (HEIM-1).

observed_at_start.description: Time family (bitemporal, HEIM-10): when reality happened, start. ISO-8601 with offset.

observed_at_end.description: Time family (bitemporal): when reality happened, end. ISO-8601 with offset.

clock_basis.description: Time family: names the clock trusted for observed_at (v1: device_metadata). 'inferred' represents timing uncertainty explicitly rather than silently faking it (HEIM-10).

captured_at.description: Time family: when the raw evidence reached Heimdal's raw layer. Distinct from envelope timestamp (publication) and observed_at_* (reality).

attributions.description: Actors family (§1.3 actors): who was involved. At least one attribution is required (payload rule 1).

resolution.description: Three-state resolution (§3.3, HEIM-6/HEIM-11) -- never a free-text name as canonical identity.

entity_mentions.description: Entities family (§1.3 entities): non-actor entity mentions (companies, projects, places, named things). Same three-state resolution as attributions.

modality.description: Content family: v1 ships 'speech'; later modalities are additive (§1.3 content).

content.description: Content family: the minimized published form (v1: attributed transcript text). No raw audio -- privacy (HEIM-4).

content_structure.description: Content family: segment boundaries + per-segment timing/confidence.

raw_ref.description: Content family: opaque reference into the raw layer (never a URL, path, or key -- resolvable only through the policy-gated raw read path, §7/HEIM-5).

withheld.description: Content family: declares degraded/omitted spans and why (payload rule 4 -- absence must be explicit, never silent).

confidence.description: Confidence family (§2): structured block of orthogonal per-axis scores, never a single scalar.

provenance.description: Provenance family (§1.3 provenance). Payload rule 1 requires content_hash + content_identity + capture_chain on every published event.

capture_chain.description: Every hop the evidence took before Heimdal (v1: ['ios_voice_memos', 'icloud_drive', 'folder_watch']) -- makes the trust boundary legible per event (§7).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonicalized published content (KERNEL-06).

content_identity.description: Hash of the raw evidence (KAP-compatible join key).

stage_versions.description: ASR/attribution/resolution stage versions for replay lineage (§5.3).

sensitivity.description: Reuses the existing _defs.schema.json sensitivity value family verbatim (schemas/_defs.schema.json).

scope_hint.description: Names the capture scope stamped at capture (v1: the operator's dedicated high-sensitivity capture scope, §1.5).

consent.description: Sensitivity/consent family (§1.3, HEIM-3): consent is required on every event. grant_ref is mandatory -- a payload missing consent.grant_ref must be rejected.

grant_ref.description: Points into the consent ledger (§6). Required on every event (HEIM-3) -- never null/empty.
